subject.title: fix(reef): add timeout and bounded JSON reads to relay transport

question: Should all Reef relay REST operations fail after a fixed 15-second deadline, including healthy but slow send, pull, acknowledgement, and relationship operations?
rationale: Source and proof establish that a deadline prevents indefinite channel stalls, but the repository context does not establish 15 seconds as the intended compatibility contract for every Reef relay operation.

options.title: Approve the fixed deadline
options.body: Confirm 15 seconds as the Reef-wide REST deadline after the branch is reduced to Reef-only changes.

options.title: Choose an operation-aware budget
options.body: Use documented owner-selected deadlines for operations that may legitimately require different response times.

options.title: Pause the policy change
options.body: Keep the PR open until Reef relay latency expectations and upgrade impact are established.

recommendation.title: Approve the fixed deadline
recommendation.body: Confirm 15 seconds as the Reef-wide REST deadline after the branch is reduced to Reef-only changes.

likelyOwner.reason: This person most recently changed and proved the exact Reef transport request path on current main.
